# Golden Lady

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

The Golden Lady has long golden hair that reaches all the way down to her feet. She wears a dress that glitters and glistens as if it were living gold.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Personality

The Golden Lady spends her time continuously playing a golden harp. The sound of her music can be heard along the shore, though it is often mistaken by most people for the wind blowing through the rocks.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)_

## Traits

_Not yet known._

## Abilities

- plays on a golden harp all day long  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

The Golden Lady was an imaginary figure created by [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) in his fictional stories. She was described as one of his rock friends living at the shore alongside [Nora](../character/nora.md) and the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md). [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) wrote about her and his other imaginary companions in a student composition that was shared by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), +2 more_
